<thought>All given resistance measurements are consistent with a single line of three series resistors between terminals B and X2, with intermediate nodes Nc2 and Nc1. The measured values imply: B‑Nc2 = 20 Ω, Nc2‑Nc1 = 15 Ω, Nc1‑X2 = 10 Ω. These three resistors (R1, R2, R3) in series reproduce every listed measurement. The required JSON therefore lists the three resistor values and their connections.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 20.0, "R2": 15.0, "R3": 10.0}, "connections": [["B", "Nc2", "R1"], ["Nc2", "Nc1", "R2"], ["Nc1", "X2", "R3"]]}</final_answer>
